title: Identification and validation of BLK and OSBPL10 as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers for nasopharyngeal carcinoma through machine learning algorithms.
authors: Zhang, Luying; Dong, Guohui; Chen, Huilin; Deng, Mengxia; Pan, Yun; Gao, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习筛选鼻咽癌诊断预后基因标志物，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Despite substantial advances in radiotherapy and chemotherapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), a subset of patients still develops metastasis or recurrence following initial treatment. Additionally, the atypical early symptoms of NPC often lead to clinical misdiagnosis or missed diagnosis, resulting in late diagnosis and unfavorable prognosis. Thus, novel diagnostic biomarkers are urgently required. By integrating five GEO datasets and applying four machine learning models, namely LASSO, SVM-RFE, XGBOOST, and mRMR, this study identified two key NPC-related genes, BLK and OSBPL10. Bioinformatic analyses revealed that both genes are significantly downregulated in NPC, and this downregulation pattern was further validated in the GSE61218 dataset. Notably, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves confirmed their high diagnostic efficacy for NPC. BLK and OSBPL10 are involved in pathways such as B-cell receptor signaling and lipid metabolic regulation, respectively, and are closely associated with the infiltration of various immune cells. Immunohistochemical staining validation further confirmed that the protein expression levels of BLK and OSBPL10 are downregulated in NPC tissues compared with those in benign lesions, and their low expression is strongly associated with the poor prognosis of patients. In summary, these findings indicated that BLK and OSBPL10 may serve as candidate biomarkers for NPC diagnosis and prognosis, although further validation in independent cohorts is warranted.
abstract_zh: 尽管鼻咽癌（NPC）的放疗和化疗取得了显著进展，但部分患者在初次治疗后仍会出现转移或复发。此外，NPC早期症状不典型，常导致临床误诊或漏诊，从而造成晚期诊断和不良预后。因此，亟需新的诊断生物标志物。通过整合五个GEO数据集并应用四种机器学习模型，即LASSO、SVM-RFE、XGBOOST和mRMR，本研究识别出两个关键的NPC相关基因，BLK和OSBPL10。生物信息学分析显示，这两个基因在NPC中均显著下调，且这一下调模式在GSE61218数据集中得到进一步验证。值得注意的是，受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线证实了它们对NPC的高诊断效能。BLK和OSBPL10分别参与B细胞受体信号传导和脂质代谢调控等通路，并与多种免疫细胞的浸润密切相关。免疫组织化学染色验证进一步证实，与良性病变相比，NPC组织中BLK和OSBPL10的蛋白表达水平下调，且其低表达与患者的不良预后密切相关。总之，这些发现表明BLK和OSBPL10可能作为NPC诊断和预后的候选生物标志物，但仍需在独立队列中进行进一步验证。
